props.name: account_id

props.name: mode
props.description: Widget Mode

props.name: name
props.description:
Human readable widget name. Not unique. Cloudflare suggests that you
set this to a meaningful string to make it easier to identify your widget, and
where it is used.

props.name: direction
props.description: Direction to order widgets.

props.name: filter
props.description:
Filter widgets by field using case-insensitive substring matching.
Format: `field:value`

Supported fields:

- `name` - Filter by widget name (e.g., `filter=name:login-form`)
- `sitekey` - Filter by sitekey (e.g., `filter=sitekey:0x4AAA`)

Returns 400 Bad Request if the field is unsupported or format is invalid. An
empty filter value returns all results.

props.name: order
props.description: Field to order widgets by.

props.name: page
props.description: Page number of paginated results.

props.name: per_page
props.description: Number of items per page.

props.name: bot_fight_mode
props.description:
If bot_fight_mode is set to `true`, Cloudflare issues
computationally expensive challenges in response to malicious bots (ENT only).

props.name: clearance_level
props.description:
If Turnstile is embedded on a Cloudflare site and the widget should
grant challenge clearance, this setting can determine the clearance level to be
set

props.name: ephemeral_id
props.description: Return the Ephemeral ID in /siteverify (ENT only).

props.name: offlabel
props.description: Do not show any Cloudflare branding on the widget (ENT only).

props.name: region
props.description:
Region where this widget can be used. This cannot be changed after
creation.

methods.name: rotateSecret
methods.summary: Generate a new secret key for this widget.
methods.description:
Generate a new secret key for this widget. If `invalidate_immediately` is set to
`false`, the previous secret remains valid for 2 hours.

Note that secrets cannot be rotated again during the grace period.

props.description: Identifier

props.name: invalidate_immediately
props.description:
If `invalidate_immediately` is set to `false`, the previous secret
will remain valid for two hours. Otherwise, the secret is immediately
invalidated, and requests using it will be rejected.
